text: My day follows a consistent pattern, which helps me stay productive and relaxed. I wake up at six-thirty every morning, stretch for ten minutes, and then make a strong cup of coffee. After a quick breakfast, I start work at eight o'clock, usually answering emails and focusing on my main tasks until noon. In the afternoon, I take a short walk outside to clear my head before finishing my projects. Exercise is important to me, so I go for a run or do yoga at the local gym around five. Evenings are for cooking a simple dinner, reading a bit, and watching a light show. By ten-thirty, I’m in bed, ready to repeat the routine tomorrow.
